name: Ootori Satsuki
source:
Satsuki is the friend of [url=https://vndb.org/c67854]Reika[/url] and a "very long time" friend of [url=https://vndb.org/c11969]Ayaka[/url]. She is also the art club president.

Satsuki seems very severe and has (literally) a killer look. She scares a lot of students when she only frown an eyebrow (and they make them think they will die when she frowns both).

Reika often compares the relationship between Satsuki and Ayaka as being similar to that between a legal guardian and his adopted child.

[spoiler]Satsuki has a totally different look when she's with her two friends, but she's not very happy with Ayaka right now because she's zooming in on all the club sessions.

Ayaka often tells [url=https://vndb.org/c19116]Akihito[/url] that one should not trust the first impression that Satsuki makes of herself, because she is very friendly, adorable and kind in reality. Appearances are deceptive.[/spoiler]
